description: Get the security bulletins and announced changes of hosting and data platforms, which are not npm packages and never show in a lockfile: Vercel, Supabase, Neon and the other platforms of the platform parameter. Returns up to 50, newest first; omit platform for all of them. For npm packages, use get_advisories.

platform.description: One platform: vercel, supabase, cloudflare, railway, neon, postgres, clerk. Omit for every platform.
